quest.occultism:ritual_dummy/custom_ritu: &5Summoning Rituals
Call forth spirits from the Otherworld.
&7Summoning rituals bind &5spirits&7 from the Otherworld into our realm.
Draw the correct &epentacle&7 with chalk, place the &6Golden Sacrificial Bowl&7 in the center, add the required ingredients, and trigger the ritual.
&eTier matters:&7 Foliot, Djinni, Afrit, and finally Marid require increasingly rare chalks and components.
&6Consult the Dictionary of Spirits&7 to learn each ritual's recipe.
quest.occultism:chalk_red_impure.title: &cImpure Red Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_red_impure.quest_s: Bind the spark of Djinn into chalk form.
quest.occultism:chalk_red_impure.quest_d: &7Red chalk is the &csecond-tier&7 ritual chalk, used to summon and bind &cDjinni&7 spirits.
Craft it by performing the appropriate &eDjinni ritual&7 on a piece of &fwhite chalk&7 with the required catalysts.
&eUsed for:&7 advanced summoning pentacles, crafting rituals, and unlocking the path to &6Marid&7 magic.
quest.occultism:dimensional_mineshaft.qu: &7The &5Dimensional Mineshaft&7 lets a bound &6Foliot Miner&7 dig endlessly in the Otherworld and bring ores back to you.
&ePlace a Miner Spirit&7 (crafted via ritual) inside the mineshaft along with fuel.
Different miner tiers yield different resources: &7stone, &firon, &6gold, &bdiamond, &cnetherite&7, and beyond.
&aA fully automated, infinite ore farm. Use it well.
quest.occultism:ritual_dummy/custom_ritu: &6Crafting Rituals
Forge items only spirits can shape.
&7Crafting rituals call upon spirits to assemble items beyond mortal hands.
Draw the matching &epentacle&7, place the &6Golden Sacrificial Bowl&7 in the center, and toss the required ingredients on the ground around it.
&eExamples:&7 Storage Stabilizers, Familiar Rings, Demonic Crystals, and the Storage Controller core.
&6See the Dictionary of Spirits&7 for the exact pentacle and ingredient list.
quest.occultism:chalk_lime_impure.title: &aImpure Lime Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_lime_impure.quest_: &7Lime chalk is used in select &asummoning pentacles&7 to bind nature-aligned Foliots.
Craft it by completing the &elime chalk ritual&7 in the Dictionary of Spirits.
&eRequired for:&7 advanced familiar and animal-affinity rituals.
quest.occultism:ritual_dummy/custom_ritu: &5Possession Rituals
Bind a spirit inside a living vessel.
&7Possession rituals force a spirit into a hostile mob, transforming it into a useful drop machine.
&eExamples:&7 possessed Endermite (Endermen Essence), possessed Skeleton, possessed Ghast.
Draw the pentacle, place a &eGolden Sacrificial Bowl&7, drop in the catalyst, then trigger the ritual near the target mob.
&6One of the only reliable ways to farm rare boss-tier drops.
quest.occultism:chalk_orange_impure.ques: Mid-tier chalk for fire and travel rituals.
&7Orange chalk is used in pentacles related to &6fire-aligned Djinni&7 and travel magic.
Craft it via the matching &eDjinni crafting ritual&7 in the Dictionary of Spirits.
&eUsed for:&7 transportation, fast-travel, and Foliot/Djinni hybrid pentacles.
quest.occultism:chalk_gray_impure.title: &8Impure Gray Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_gray_impure.quest_: &7Gray chalk fills the auxiliary marks of many pentacles.
Craft it via the &egray chalk ritual&7. Cheap to produce and used in bulk.
&eAlways keep a stack on hand&7 before attempting any high-tier summoning.
quest.occultism:chalk_green_impure.title: &2Impure Green Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_green_impure.quest: Chalk woven with growth and life.
&7Green chalk is required by &2nature&7 and &agrowth&7 themed rituals.
Crafted from a Djinni-tier ritual. Pairs well with lime chalk in advanced pentacles.
&eRequired for:&7 select familiar bindings and farming-aid rituals.
quest.occultism:chalk_black_impure.title: &0Impure Black Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_black_impure.quest: &7Black chalk is the &8third-tier&7 ritual chalk, bound to powerful &cAfrit&7 spirits.
Craft it through a multi-step &eAfrit ritual&7 requiring red and white chalks already on hand.
&eUnlocks:&7 Afrit Essence rituals, high-tier crafting pentacles, and the road to &dMarid&7.
quest.occultism:chalk_pink_impure.title: &dImpure Pink Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_pink_impure.quest_: Chalk used in familiar and bond rituals.
&7Pink chalk decorates pentacles that &dbind familiars&7 (cats, beholders, dragons, bats, etc.) to the summoner.
Craft it via the &epink chalk ritual&7 in the Dictionary of Spirits.
&eFamiliars&7 grant passive buffs and help in combat. Worth the chalk.
quest.occultism:chalk_blue_impure.title: &9Impure Blue Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_blue_impure.quest_: &7Blue chalk is the &9fourth and highest-tier&7 ritual chalk, used only for &9Marid&7 summoning.
Requires a chain of &eAfrit-tier rituals&7 to produce.
&eUnlocks:&7 the strongest Occultism crafting recipes, including the &6Storage Controller&7 ecosystem.
Chalk for water and storage rituals.
&7Light blue chalk is found in pentacles linked to &bdimensional storage&7 and water-aligned spirits.
Craft it via the matching ritual. Pairs with white and blue chalk in late-game pentacles.
&eEssential&7 for completing the Storage Controller crafting chain.
quest.occultism:chalk_magenta_impure.que: &7Magenta chalk appears in &dpossession&7 and transformation pentacles.
Craft it through its dedicated &eDjinni ritual&7.
&eUsed for:&7 binding spirits into mobs to harvest rare drops.
quest.occultism:chalk_cyan_impure.title: &3Impure Cyan Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_cyan_impure.quest_: &7Cyan chalk is used in pentacles tied to the &3Otherworld dimension&7 and its inhabitants.
Craft it via the corresponding ritual once you have access to higher-tier chalks.
quest.occultism:chalk_brown_impure.title: &6Impure Brown Chalk
quest.occultism:chalk_brown_impure.quest: Chalk grounded in earth and stone.
&7Brown chalk fills support marks in many earth-themed pentacles.
Craft it through its &eFoliot-tier ritual&7 once basic chalks are available.
&eFrequently paired&7 with gray chalk for utility rituals.
quest.occultism:ritual_dummy/custom_ritu: &eMiscellaneous Rituals
Utility rituals for everyday occultists.
&7Not every ritual summons a spirit or crafts an item. Some simply &etwist the world around you&7.
&eExamples:&7 weather control, time skip, mob clearing, dimension travel, repair effects.
&6Open the Dictionary of Spirits&7 and browse the &eMiscellaneous Rituals&7 page to see what's possible.
&aOften cheaper than their crafting equivalents and great for quality-of-life.
